description: Files an earlier package installed that later packages no longer ship. The installer backs up and removes a file listed here only when its SHA-256 matches exactly; any other extra file still stops the update for inspection. Paths are relative to the mod's own folder in the native mods directory or the BepInEx plugin folder.
